## Validation

<!-- Commands and actual results; tested commit SHA; final-head GitHub CI links
     and review findings. Distinguish source-reviewed, Azure-executed, and
     independently reproduced. Azure claims need retained run/source/environment/
     date/evidence/recovery/cleanup records; otherwise NOT_RUN. No fabricated dates. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] Documentation build and related checks were run.
- [ ] CLI commands use long flags, and any command claimed as validated was actually executed.
- [ ] No subscription IDs, tenant IDs, object IDs, emails, secrets, or other PII were added.
- [ ] Links and source metadata were updated where applicable.
- [ ] Screenshots were visually checked and sanitized when applicable.
- [ ] Final committed image bytes (including re-encoded WebP) match captions/alt text and were visually checked for PII, or no images changed.
- [ ] Required GitHub CI and review findings are recorded for the final head SHA; blocking findings are resolved and no gate was bypassed.
- [ ] Scope and overengineering were assessed; verification dates and claims reflect work actually performed.

<!-- A checklist is not merge authorization. Only the responsible maintainer may
     authorize squash merge after required checks and applicable image/PII review.
     AI feedback/scores are optional advisory material. -->
